name: careerpilot-ai-root
description: CareerPilot AI - AI-Powered Career, Skill-Gap & Placement Intelligence Platform

scripts.build: if [ -d "client" ]; then cd client && npm install && npm run build; else npm install && npm run build; fi
scripts.server:build: if [ -d "server" ]; then cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build; else npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build; fi
scripts.start: if [ -d "server" ]; then cd server && npm start; else npm start; fi
